questions.question: We just formed a Delaware C corporation and plan to hire our first employee next month. How do we get an employer identification number from the IRS, and how far ahead of our first payroll do we need to apply?
Two cofounders formed a Colorado LLC and never filed any tax election with the IRS. How is the LLC classified for federal income tax purposes by default?
mustNot: taxed as a corporation by default

questions.question: Our LLC was formed four months ago, and we now want it taxed as a C corporation starting from the day it was formed. Can the entity classification election on Form 8832 be backdated that far?

Our Delaware corporation has a venture fund organized as an LLC among its stockholders, and one cofounder is a foreign citizen who has never lived in the United States. Can the corporation elect to be an S corporation?

Our calendar-year C corporation wants S corporation status starting with its 2027 tax year. What is the last day the election can be made and still take effect for 2027, and whose consent does it need?

I just received founder shares that vest over four years, and my lawyer says I should elect to be taxed now on their current value instead of as they vest. How long do I have to file that election with the IRS?
Our board wants to grant nonqualified stock options to early employees with an exercise price below the stock's current fair market value. What federal tax problem does that create for the employees?
We are a seed-stage startup. How should we value our common stock for option grants so that the IRS presumes the exercise price is reasonable?

A departing executive who was let go without cause is negotiating severance paid in installments over three years. Is that severance treated as deferred compensation under the federal deferred compensation tax rules, or is there an exception for it?
Our board adopted a stock option plan 14 months ago, but the stockholders never voted on it. Can options granted under that plan qualify as incentive stock options?

An early engineer was granted incentive stock options covering $250,000 of stock, measured at its value on the grant date, and all of it becomes exercisable for the first time next year. Do all of those options keep their incentive stock option status?
Several employees exercised incentive stock options at our company this year. By what date must we give each of them the written statement about the exercise (Form 3921)?
An angel investor bought common shares from one of the cofounders in a private secondary sale rather than from the company. Can those shares be qualified small business stock?

I bought shares directly from a startup C corporation in 2026. How long do I have to hold them to exclude part of my gain under the qualified small business stock rules, and how long to exclude all of it?
For qualified small business stock I acquired from one startup in 2026, what is the most gain I can exclude when I sell that company's stock?

Our angel group pools members' money in an SPV LLC taxed as a partnership to buy preferred stock in a startup C corporation. When the SPV later sells that stock, can the members claim the qualified small business stock gain exclusion, and does it matter when each member joined the SPV?
Two founders are each transferring equipment and IP they own to a new Delaware C corporation in exchange for all of its stock, and one founder also receives $20,000 in cash. Is any of this taxable?

When we incorporate, the property one founder contributes is subject to a loan that the new corporation will take over, and the loan is larger than that founder's tax basis in that property. Does that create taxable gain for the founder?
Our startup is putting its founders on salary. Apart from what it withholds from their paychecks, what Social Security and Medicare tax does the company itself owe on their wages?
We ran our startup's first payroll this year. How often do we have to deposit the withheld income tax and FICA taxes with the IRS, and when is each deposit due?

When our startup ran low on cash, my cofounder, the CEO, used the money withheld from employees' paychecks to pay vendors instead of the IRS. Can the IRS collect that from us personally, and if I end up paying it, can I make my cofounder pay a share?
In 2026 our startup paid a freelance designer $1,500 for a logo. Do we have to file an information return with the IRS reporting that payment?
Our Delaware C corporation uses the calendar year. When is its federal income tax return due, before any extension?
Our pre-revenue software startup has research credits but no income tax to use them against. Can we apply the credit against payroll taxes instead, and what are the limits?
After our Series A and Series B, new investors own most of our C corporation. Can we still use our net operating loss carryforwards in full?

An angel sold qualified small business stock held for two years at a large gain. Can the angel defer tax on that gain by putting the money into another startup, and how quickly does the reinvestment have to happen?

I bought shares directly from a small startup for cash, and the company has now failed, leaving the stock worthless. Can I deduct the loss against ordinary income instead of as a capital loss, and is there a cap?
Our angel SPV, an LLC taxed as a partnership with 40 members, filed its partnership return four months late with no extension. How is the IRS penalty calculated?
I am the general partner of a venture fund. If the fund sells a portfolio company it held for two years, is my carried interest share of the gain taxed as long-term capital gain?

A university endowment is a limited partner in our venture fund, and the fund holds an interest in an operating LLC taxed as a partnership. Does the endowment owe tax on its share of that LLC's business income even if nothing is distributed to it?

Our fund has a foreign limited partner, and through an operating partnership the fund earns income effectively connected with a U.S. business. Does the fund have to withhold tax on that partner's share, and at what rate?
We manage a venture fund organized as a limited partnership and are thinking of letting our LPs trade their fund interests on an online secondary platform. Could that change how the fund is taxed?

Our company is settling a dispute with a former cofounder by paying the settlement into that cofounder's lawyer's client trust account. The lawyer never did any work for us. Do we have to report the payment to the lawyer to the IRS?

In a dispute with my former cofounder, the cofounder claims the IRS can still assess more tax on our corporation's return that was filed on time five years ago. Generally how long does the IRS have to assess tax after a return is filed, and when is that period longer?
